speaker: customer
text: So what is this plan exactly?

speaker: agent
text: You told me your real worry is Aanya’s college in fourteen years. This plan locks a guaranteed amount for exactly that year — whatever the markets do, that number does not move.

speaker: agent
text: Fixed. Like an FD, but it forces the discipline monthly, and adds life cover on you till then.

speaker: customer
text: And if something happens to me in between?

speaker: agent
text: The premiums stop, and the college amount stays. That is the whole point of it being an education plan and not just savings.
